verdict_reason: The test is sound and goes red if the interceptor stops mapping a token 503, but it copies the token request matcher already held in IntegrationBase.

todos.issue: TokenEndpointUnavailableIT.java:24 copies the token request matcher request().withMethod("POST").withPath("/trade-auth/token") that IntegrationBase.java:159 already has inside stubTradeAuthToken, so the token endpoint's method and path now live in two IT files and a change to one leaves the other stubbing a path nothing calls.
todos.fix: Must: IntegrationBase is the one place that defines the token endpoint request; this test and stubTradeAuthToken both use it. One way: add a protected tradeAuthTokenRequest() or stubTradeAuthTokenAnswering(int status) to IntegrationBase, mirroring searchRequest and stubSearchAnswering in CommoditiesControllerIT.
